blocks.text: Pages are those the project's own search returns for "Uganda", so some only mention it. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 105 pages on Wikiversity mention Uganda, written from 2003 onward and read 1,733,791 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 1,021 times.
“Living With a Narcissist” alone holds 28.8% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 87%. Readership is highly concentrated, so a few pages decide the story.
Views peaked in 2019 at 362,925. The last full year, 2025, drew 130,457, 64% below the peak. So far in 2026: 114,978 views.
Most pages were written in 2015 (20). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 12 pages were written, against 20 in the five years before that — the pace is slowing.
562 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2014 (77); in 2025 there were 8. A thin recent base: a handful of people carry the upkeep.
26% of pages are stubs (under 1,000 bytes) and 31% are long (20,000 bytes and over).
“No Wikidata item” affects 93 pages (89%). Suggested action: Connect to Wikidata.
11% of pages are linked to a Wikidata item, and 10% have no Luganda article for the subject — 10 candidates for translation.
10% of pages were edited in the last year; 42 (40%) have not been touched for five years or more.

blocks.text: Pages written, edits and editors come from each page's own edit history, so they reach back to the first page. Views are recorded only from July 2015. Editors are registered accounts, counted once a year.
